_public_note: Public build manifest. Verbatim retail source strings are stored as SHA-256 digests (fields ending in _sha256); the builder recomputes them from the user's own ROM. Japanese text in this file is written by this project.
_authority: Tracked production authority for the earlier layer's law names and antilaw cards. The builder ffta_jp_us_law_semantics.py derives every row again from the pristine US text and the base image on every build and fails on any difference; nothing here is trusted. Markup: {HEX} is a CTR_FUNC operand; every other character is text.
evidence: the US law names and antilaw cards (FORBIDDEN / RECOMMEND pairs) compared with the JP rule names, law by law
authoring_rule: Law names become the US category: names 1..83 ending in the JP 'forbidden' suffix lose it; the six 'X protection' laws 77..82 (US 'Dmg2: X') become 'against X'. Antilaw cards follow the US pair: page 1 'cancels the following laws / usable in battle', page 2 'forbidden <X>' and 'bonus <Y>' with the US grade. 'Bonus' is the word the recommended laws' own HELP uses; the Japanese characters for 'recommended' are not JP retail glyphs and the Latin I/D for the screen's RECOMMEND/FORBIDDEN are not allocated.
